Team — I reviewed Karin's traffic sample and ran a quick sizing exercise (attached sizing_calculation_20270619.xlsx). Summary / recommendation:

- Baseline throughput target: 900k tokens/day, p95 latency target <= 350ms token gen for chat-like workload at median seq 150.
- Preferred GPU: 80GB A800 (or A100s if A800 not available) for production-heavy endpoints — better KV cache headroom and batch throughput.
- Recommended pilot capacity (dedicated pool in EU):
  • Production: 6 x 80GB GPUs (continuous), tuned with continuous batching and prefix caching
  • Staging: 2 x 80GB GPUs (on-demand)
  • Burst buffer: ability to burst additional 2 x 80GB for up to 4 hours/day when traffic spikes > 2x baseline

Rationale: 6 prod GPUs provide sufficient model concurrency to keep p95 under target for the stated workload while allowing for warm KV caches. The burst policy reduces reserved commit while preserving SLOs. For cost-optimizing, we can propose a 3-month reserved commit equivalent to ~1,800 GPU-hours/mo, with burst capacity billed separately.

Ops notes / lead time:
- Host networking + KMS integration: 3 business days once we have network/IP allowlist and service account details.
- Provisioning of images + canary tests: 2 business days.
- Total minimum lead time: 5 business days (fits Jun 28th target if we start Monday).

Attachments: sizing_calculation_20270619.xlsx
